behavior: Type matchup entries belong to defending types. A listed weakness contributes 2, resistance 1/2, immunity 0, otherwise 1. Conflicting authored memberships use weakness before resistance before immunity.
preconditions: Registered type identities and ordinary base matchup evaluation; battle-specific overrides are separate.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Type list duplicates are removed per record; undefined listed counterpart types fail whole-table validation after records have been registered.
preconditions: Generic Type compiler reached normally; no automatic transaction rollback claimed.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Ability names/descriptions have omission defaults; flags are data strings and flag comparisons ignore letter case.
preconditions: Valid unique identity and ordinary dependencies; raw values and localized output are separate.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: FasterEggHatching is consumed by the step callback: after the first decrement, scan current non-egg party members, apply one extra decrement at the first matching active ability flag, then stop.
preconditions: Normal step event, current player/party and ability access successful; callbacks and hatch presentation normal.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: A move Status category with positive power is rejected. Physical/Special with zero or omitted power warns and becomes Status; valid positive damage values survive this check.
preconditions: New unique move, lexical fields and enum references valid, warning returns normally; no full-table save until normal completion.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Move effect names are text identities. Missing named runtime effect uses generic fallback rather than enum parse rejection: Status fails at the move gate, damaging categories retain ordinary damage without a special effect.
preconditions: Valid move already registered and ordinary action gates reached; no added matching implementation or plugin; caller-specific PP remains separate.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Battle move construction reads type, category, power, accuracy, target, priority, flags and additional-effect chance from move data.
preconditions: Valid move instance and battle construction; later effective-value overrides and move-specific effects remain unreviewed here.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Data effect chance 101 is a legal nonnegative integer. The additional-effect chance consumer preserves values above 100 before doubling or debug override, after the Shield Dust gate.
preconditions: This exact chance calculation reached with effective target ability/mold-breaker state; later invocation and actual application remain separate.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Item omission defaults include pocket 1, price 0, sell price integer half of purchase price, BP price 1, no field/battle use. Importance means KeyItem/TM/HM, and effective consumption requires a non-important item.
preconditions: Valid registered item and relevant direct query; use eligibility, action execution, bag bounds and UI drawing are separate.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Portion names omitted from an item fall back separately to ordinary singular and plural names. Their localization remains distinct.
preconditions: Raw portion field missing, or present nonempty localization lookup as stated; PBS empty field is not assumed to be a stored empty string.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Berry numeric schema: positive hours, nonnegative drying, nonnegative first yield and positive second yield. Construction supplies 3/15/2,5 when missing, and reverses yields if the second is smaller.
preconditions: A registered berry record; a missing whole record is a different strict lookup failure.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Berry record identity is a symbolic section key; no Item enum exists in its schema and both berry validators are empty. Runtime interaction associates the identity with item content.
preconditions: Compiler/runtime stages separated; item existence and berry flag eligibility do not establish berry data existence.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Berry stage duration is hours times 3600. New-mechanic yield uses the integer quotient of maximum times (5-penalty) over 5, bounded below by minimum; old watering yield uses the configured range.
preconditions: Planted state and forward time for update, no mulch unless explicitly chosen; random/sample calculations do not execute the game.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Base species and form author schemas differ. Fields absent in forms inherit from base in named groups, while any explicit wild-item family prevents inheriting all three wild-item groups.
preconditions: Valid base species already registered; form identity conversion and prior validation normal. Detailed runtime form handlers remain separate.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Species base-stat author columns map HP, attack, defense, speed, special attack, special defense; EV output uses stat-name/positive-value pairs, and repeated stat keys retain the later value during hash construction.
preconditions: Six positive authored base stats; hardcoded main stat PBS order and legal stat identities required. Battle/stat formulas are separate.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Species height and weight are converted to tenths, rounded, and bounded below by one; omitted forms inherit base values.
preconditions: Prior lexical float acceptance; this review instrument does not reproduce all malformed input parsing.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Evolution target/parameter and offspring references include deferred validation. Required evolution parameters are checked before registration; base finalization converts parameter kinds and builds first-found reverse ancestry.
preconditions: Registry phase and record order matter; absence-free literal relation joins do not certify all temporal prerequisites or callbacks.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Level-up move reset filters by current level in authored order, retains the last occurrence of duplicate moves, and takes the final maximum-move-count entries.
preconditions: Valid current species data and level; full WP30 contract has not been read, so the destination is only a scope pointer.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Tutor move compatibility uses membership. Duplicate TutorMoves atoms do not create an extra affirmative compatibility result.
preconditions: Valid registered queried move; this only resolves the membership result, not all tutoring workflows.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Metrics section identity references a species and optional positive form. Missing metric lookup for a valid species registers defaults or a cloned base metric, and sprite adjustment doubles configured offsets.
preconditions: Valid existing species; record mutation and source suffix of generated data remain observable; full metric rendering/export clauses pending.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Shadow input is optional. Gauge is positive, default 4000; ordered move IDs are filtered by runtime existence and capped at MAX_MOVES during conversion. Missing per-form record falls back to base; missing all data retains default gauge and may use SHADOWRUSH if registered.
preconditions: Conditional valid loading of the optional overlay; no automatic activation or reference compilation performed.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.

behavior: Current active bulk families exactly match their Gen 8 backup bytes. Metrics are identical in all five profiles; modern berry/type files have additional exact-byte duplicates. This proves data identity only.
preconditions: 44 individually Git-blob-checked files at fixed snapshot. Other backup content and settings cannot be certified by these byte matches.
preserved_scope: Fixed reference behavior only; not architecture, execution evidence, official game guarantees, or variant support certification.
